title: Lost in the Funnel: Selection-Induced Miscalibration in Ranking and Decision Systems
abstract: arXiv:2611.22595v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Modern ranking and decision systems combine components with divergent objectives, and scores calibrated at the model boundary are used as calibrated probabilities throughout the funnel, across filtering, reranking, business-rule enforcement, and auctions. Yet calibration is typically validated only where the score is produced, so its breakdown where the score is used is routinely overlooked. We ask when calibration survives this selection, how inherited error differs from selection effects, and what can fail for a perfectly calibrated score at a component boundary. We study these questions through a boundary-wise diagnostic framework of residual identities. We target rubric-judged relevance rather than presentation-dependent metrics such as CTR, so calibration is measurable at every funnel layer of interest. We first present an industry-wide case study that applies our diagnosis to settings where calibration deteriorates at decision time

translated_title: 迷失于漏斗之中：排序与决策系统中由选择引发的校准失效
translated_abstract: 现代排序和决策系统将具有不同目标的多个组件组合在一起，在模型边界处校准的分数在整个漏斗流程中——涵盖过滤、重排序、业务规则执行和拍卖——被当作校准后的概率来使用。然而，校准通常只在分数产生的地方进行验证，因此分数在其实际使用处的校准失效往往被忽视。我们探究了校准在何种情况下能在这种选择过程中得以保持、继承性误差与选择效应有何不同，以及在组件边界处完美校准的分数可能出现何种问题。我们通过一个基于残差恒等式的逐边界诊断框架来研究这些问题。我们以评分标准判定的相关性为目标，而非点击率（CTR）等依赖于展示方式的指标，因此校准可以在每个感兴趣的漏斗层级上被测量。我们首先呈现了一项全行业范围的案例研究，将该诊断方法应用于校准在决策时发生恶化的场景。
tldr: 该论文提出了一个基于残差恒等式的逐边界诊断框架，揭示排序与决策系统中在模型边界处校准良好的分数会因下游选择过程（如过滤、重排序、业务规则和拍卖）而失效，并通过全行业案例研究展示了校准在决策时刻的恶化。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a boundary-wise diagnostic framework based on residual identities, revealing that scores well-calibrated at the model boundary become miscalibrated through downstream selection processes in ranking and decision systems, with an industry-wide case study demonstrating calibration deterioration at decision time.
